method: read-only Playwright probes + bounding-box measurement against running dev app

bugs.shift: Phục vụ cafe cuối tuần (shift-004), Approved application
bugs.expected: Primary status badge reflects the worker's own application status; public 'Đang tuyển' must not be the main label
bugs.actual: Card primary badge showed 'Đang tuyển' while personal 'Đã được duyệt' was only a secondary pin

steps: Log in as employer with a long company name
View any employer page on desktop (1280-1920px)
Observe the header nav vs the profile zone
bugs.expected: Desktop nav never overlaps the logo or the notification/profile zone; long name truncates
bugs.actual: The 7-item employer nav (~870px) spilled ~164px into the profile zone — 'Hồ sơ doanh nghiệp' collided with 'Quán Phở Hà'. Prior LAYOUT-1 centering passed no-overflow tests but still overlapped.
bugs.suggestedFix: Adaptive header: measure whether the nav fits beside logo+profile; collapse to hamburger when it does not (employer); keep centered inline nav when it fits (worker/admin).
